text:
Maya (PM): Quick triage — we need a final pass on GA readiness for the inference-routing feature. I ran through the checklist and flagged gaps in SLA wording, pricing matrix, monitoring alerts, and support runbooks. Can owners ack and add ETA?

Alex (Eng Lead): Ack. I'll handle SLA telemetry hooks and routing fallback tests. ETA EOD Wed.

Liang (SRE): Noted. Monitoring dashboards exist but alert thresholds need tuning. Missing: SLO burn rate alert, multi-region failover alert. I'll push PR by Tue.

Sam (Docs): I have draft runbook and user-facing FAQ. Need exact SLA numbers and pricing table to finalize. Can @Priya confirm pricing tiers?

Priya (Sales): Pricing tiers we agreed: Starter / Scale / Enterprise. Need to confirm per-token rates and committed capacity discounts. Sending numbers in DM; will post final by Tue AM.

Jordan (Support): Oncall playbook is thin around model fallback behavior and customer notification. Can we add a short template for P1 vs degraded-quality incidents?

Maya (PM): Good. I'll add a template. Also, two immediate asks: 1) SLA numerics to finalize docs; 2) Confirm whether Dedicated customers require custom SLAs. @Alex please confirm technical feasibility.

Alex (Eng Lead): Dedicated customers can have stricter SLOs but requires reserved capacity + capacity guarantees. Feasible, but needs procurement for Dedicated pool. I'll note in the rollout doc.

Liang (SRE): FYI, current monitoring gaps I saw: no KV-cache hit-rate metric exposed to console, and no synthetic requests simulating cold-start tails. I'll add metrics and a synthetic job.

Sam (Docs): For final GA we need: user-facing SLA page, support escalation matrix, deployment/rollout notes, and an 'SLA exceptions' paragraph. I'll link the draft: https://redwood.docs/s/xyz (draft).

Maya (PM): Adding a concise acceptance checklist. Please mark done inline.

```
GA Acceptance (must pass)
- SLA page published with numeric targets and SLA credits policy
- Pricing page updated and approved by Sales
- Support runbook + oncall rotation added
- Monitoring: SLOs, burn-rate alerts, synthetic checks
- Docs: rollout notes & API contract stable
- Dedicated: capacity contract templates for Enterprise
```

Priya (Sales): Will sign off on pricing and enterprise contract template by Tue 5pm.

Jordan (Support): I'll draft P1/P2 templates and link to runbook by Tue noon.

Alex (Eng Lead): Can we get a quick perf test run? @deploy-bot can you schedule a 2k rps perf job against canary this afternoon?

deploy-bot: Scheduled perf job 1719006000; ETA 30m. Results will be posted in #eng-runtime.

Maya (PM): Great — once perf results green and PRs merged, we'll greenlight GA. I'll collate action items and owners into the release doc.

Liang (SRE): One more thing — we should set baseline latency targets (p50/p95/p99) and an error budget policy, and include explicit rollback criteria for quality regressions.

Sam (Docs): Noted. I'll add a small section in the runbook with rollback steps and customer comms templates.

Maya (PM): Thanks all — I'll update the release doc and ping again after perf results.
